name: Xiaomi MiMo
description: Xiaomi's MiMo platform with signup credit and a developer incentive programme.
overview: Xiaomi's MiMo open platform serves the natively multimodal MiMo V2.5 family through an OpenAI-compatible API at api.xiaomimimo.com/v1, usable from Claude Code, Cursor and OpenClaw. New accounts get ¥10 of API credit (about a million tokens) that stops rather than overdraws when spent, and a separate creator programme grants much larger blocks by application. Chinese accounts need real-name verification.
free_access: Larger blocks via the creator programme
notes: TTS models are currently free on the same platform, but this catalogue is text-only.

models.name: MiMo V2.5
models.rate_limits: ¥10 signup credit; creator programme grants larger blocks
